data.one_liner: Web implementation of the location plugin for Flutter web.
data.what_it_does: Provides geolocation support on web by wrapping the browser Geolocation API. It exposes the same API as the main location package, but only works on web.
use_when: You need location data in a Flutter web app
You already depend on the location package and want the web implementation automatically added
avoid_when: You target mobile or desktop platforms that require native location plugins
You need advanced geofencing or background location updates
strengths: Automatically added when depending on location
Handles permission and error mapping to PlatformException
Bug fixes for NaN heading and permission handling
weaknesses: Web only, no support for iOS/Android/desktop
Requires browsers that support Geolocation API
data.setup_notes: Add location: ^7.0.0 to pubspec; no extra permissions needed beyond browser prompts

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Cross‑platform geolocation for mobile, web, and desktop
